name: Text tools
description: Sorts the selected lines, removes duplicate lines, counts the characters of the note, and removes trailing spaces.
author: Sedum Note

commands.title: Sort the selected lines
commands.description: Sorts the lines of the selection in ascending order.

commands.title: Remove duplicate lines
commands.description: Keeps the first of each repeated line in the selection.

commands.title: Count characters
commands.description: Shows how many characters and lines the note has.

commands.title: Remove trailing spaces
commands.description: Removes the spaces at the end of every line of the note.
